About the job
Havelwind Renewables is an independent power producer backed by a Nordic infrastructure fund. We develop, build and operate solar parks and battery energy storage systems (BESS) in Germany and Poland. Our German pipeline currently holds 1.4 GW of ground-mounted PV and 600 MW of standalone and co-located storage, most of it in Brandenburg, Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

Our Head of Development Germany is on a sabbatical until mid-2027. We are looking for an experienced interim project director on a fractional basis who keeps our most advanced projects moving towards ready-to-build status and financial close.

What you will do
• Lead the development of six PV and BESS projects (together about 420 MWp and 250 MW) from land securing to ready-to-build
• Steer the permitting processes, including development plans under the German Building Code (BauGB) and environmental assessments, together with municipalities and external planners
• Manage grid connection requests and negotiations with distribution and transmission system operators, including connection agreements and cost sharing
• Prepare bids for the EEG solar tenders of the Federal Network Agency and support the PPA team with project data
• Run the EPC and BESS supplier tenders together with our procurement team
• Report to the Managing Directors and the investment committee, prepare the documentation for the lenders' technical advisor
• Coach two junior project developers

What you bring
• 10+ years in renewable energy project development or in grid-related roles in the German energy sector, with several projects brought to ready-to-build
• Sound knowledge of the German permitting framework, the EEG and grid connection processes
• Experience with EPC contracts and project finance documentation
• Fluent German and English; our investment committee works in English
• A hands-on style and the ability to work with landowners, mayors and grid operators alike

Terms
• Start: November 2026
• Duration: 6 months, extension likely
• Workload: fractional interim assignment, 3 days per week, at least one day per week in our Berlin office and regular site visits
• Day rate: €1,100 to €1,250 plus VAT and travel expenses
• Contract directly with Havelwind Renewables GmbH
